changes.diffOpenBiggestHint: The block with the most changed lines: earlier changes end up above you
changes.diffOpenImportsHint: The first change that isn't an import: nothing above it but the import list
changes.diffOpenTopHint: The first change in the file, imports and all
changes.groupByModuleHint: Group files by package in review lists.
changes.largestFirstHint: Order review lists by how much each file added, instead of by path, within each package.

chat.showToolCallsHint: Display individual tool calls in transcript.

desk.hint: Folders and files as large tiles in the main area when nothing is open. Hover a tile to look inside it.
desk.title: Desk

explorer.fileNestingHint: Fold a folder's files under its package.json in the explorer.
explorer.hideTechnicalHint: Lockfiles, configuration, dot files and build output. On by default when you don't write code.
explorer.hideTestsHint: Hide test files and folders in explorer.
explorer.showIgnoredHint: Show node_modules, build output, and gitignored paths.
explorer.title: Explorer

look.languageHint: The language this interface is written in. Your files, your chats and your agents are untouched.
look.textSizeComfortableHint: 110% — the size the interface was drawn at

theme.sanctumHint: The look of intentic.dev: ash stone, a gold rule round every panel, carved and cast plaques, and the site's own type.
theme.systemHint: Follows your operating system: Sanctum when it is dark, the light look when it is not.

work.developerHint: Git's own words, the file tree as the home, every panel.
work.hint: Changes the words the app uses and which page is home. Nothing about your files or your agents.
work.makerHint: Plain words, a project page as the home, tooling files out of the way.
work.title: How you work
